input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere: searches for "insurance", "coverage", "insured", "certificate" and "errors and omissions" return nothing, and the General Provisions (Sections 10.1–10.8) run from notices to headings without any insurance requirement. HDI hosts and operates the Site, processes order export files and has access to Company user information and customer data (Sections 1.4, 1.5, 8.1), so the rule is engaged and the absence of any coverage for a vendor processing personal data is walk-away territory. We insert a single short Section 10.9 at the preferred levels (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where HDI processes customer data, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request); the fallback (E&O USD 1M, cyber USD 2M) remains available in negotiation.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where HDI processes the Company's customer data, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance upon the Company's request.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The agreement has no insurance provision even though HDI hosts the Site and processes order and customer data, so we have added a short insurance covenant at our preferred levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if needed.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.9 requiring HDI to carry CGL, E&O, cyber and workers' compensation insurance and to provide certificates on request.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.

Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
